ledger.x: 1933: the Enabling Act of 23 March 1933 ends the Weimar Republic in law, and weimar-republic dissolves into this state in March 1933 (its lead gives 'from 9 November 1918 to 23 March 1933'); the Nazi seizure of power began on 30 January 1933 ('Seizure of power: 30…
1935: the Saar returns to Germany.
1938: the Anschluss.
1938: the Sudetenland passes to Germany.
1939: German troops enter the Czech lands.
1939: Slovakia becomes a German client state.
1939: Lithuania cedes Memel under threat of invasion by sea; the cession treaty was signed 23 March 1939.
1939: Germany invades Poland on 1 September 1939 ('Invaded 1 Sep 1939; occupied 1 Sep 1939 - 9 May 1945').
1939: Germany 'captured the Free City of Danzig on 1 September 1939'; annexed as Reichsgau Danzig-West Prussia (German-occupied Europe table).
1939: Poland partitioned.
1939: the Polish campaign ends.
1939: the General Government.
1940: Alsace-Lorraine annexed.
1940: Denmark occupied.
1940: Germany invades Norway on 9 April 1940.
1940: the Netherlands occupied from 10 May 1940 under the Reichskommissariat Niederlande; no annexation (table gives the end as 20 May 1945).
1940: Belgium occupied from 10 May 1940; parts annexed (Gau Cologne-Aachen, Reichsgau Wallonien, Reichsgau Flandern).
1940: Luxembourg occupied on 10 May 1940 (annexed as Gau Moselland, see 1942).
1940: the attack in the west begins on 10 May 1940 against France and the Low Countries.
1940: Eupen-Malmedy annexed.
1940: Norway 'was fully occupied by early June'.
1940: Norway under the Reichskommissariat Norwegen with a Norway National Government as puppet; occupied until 8 May 1945, never annexed.
1940: France 'surrendered on 22 June'.
1940: the northern and Atlantic zone of France is occupied (table: 'Occupied 10 May 1940'); Vichy France is the French State.
1940: Guernsey.
1940: Jersey.
1941: Yugoslavia invaded 6 April 1941; the Serbian Military Administration ran 30 April 1941 to January 1945 under a Commissioner Government.

ledger.x: 1941: 'Northern Yugoslavia was annexed in April 1941'; Reichsgau Karnten and Steiermark (German-occupied Europe table); the Territorial evolution page names Lower Styria without a date.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: 1941: 'It was established in parts of occupied Yugoslavia on 10 April 1941' and was 'a puppet state of Nazi Germany from 1941 to 1945' (also a protectorate of Fascist Italy 1941-1943 and, from 18 May 1941 to September 1943, 'a territorial condominium of Germany and Italy').
1941: Greece occupied from 6 April 1941 under a Military Administration with the Hellenic State as puppet; no annexation.
1941: Operation Barbarossa 'began just before dawn on 22 June 1941'.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariats Ostland and Ukraine.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariats Ostland and Ukraine.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: Moldova inside Cliopatria's 1942 shape.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union, 22 June 1941 to 10 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union from 22 June 1941 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: occupation of parts of the Soviet Union from 22 June 1941 (German-occupied Europe table); Reichskommissariat Ostland.
1941: Bezirk Bialystok.
1941: the Crimea.
1941: 6 December, the German attack on Moscow is suspended and the Soviet counteroffensive begins (furthest advance 27 November, Khimki within 30 km of the Kremlin).
1942: Case Blue launched 28 June; German troops reach the Volga at Stalingrad 23 August; Operation Uranus encircles the 6th Army 19-23 November.
1942: Luxembourg's military occupation ends in annexation: 'formally annexed to Germany in August 1942'.
1942: Luxembourg 'formally annexed to Germany in August 1942' (Gau Moselland).
1942: Case Anton, the German occupation of the Vichy 'zone libre'.
1942: Tunisia.

1943: the Red Army retakes the Russian lands: Orel is retaken on 5 August 1943 and Army Group South withdraws across the Dnieper in September; the page dates none of the other Russian recaptures (the Leningrad and Pskov regions were cleared later).
1943: the 90,000 surviving men of the 6th Army surrender at Stalingrad on 31 January 1943.
1943: 'The Axis forces surrendered on 13 May 1943 yielding over 275,000 prisoners of war' (North African campaign).

1943: German occupation of Italian territory from 8 September 1943 to 2 May 1945, with the Italian Social Republic (German-occupied Europe table); the Allied invasion of Italy is dated 3 September 1943.

1943: 'OZAK was established, with its headquarters in Trieste, on 10 September 1943, by Adolf Hitler', comprising 'the provinces of Udine, Gorizia, Trieste, Pula (Pola), Rijeka (Fiume) and Ljubljana (Lubiana)'; the sister zone of the Alpine Foothills (Belluno, South Tyrol, Trentino) 'was established on the same day'.
1943: Albania.
1943: Monaco.
1944: Hungary occupied from 19 March 1944 (Government of National Unity), to May 1945; no annexation.
1944: the Crimea retaken.
1944: Ukraine retaken.
1944: the Bialystok district goes.
1944: Operation Bagration, 'fought between 22 June and 19 August 1944', retook Belarus; Minsk was liberated on 4 July, Brest on 28 July.

1944: the Second Jassy-Kishinev offensive ran 20 to 29 August 1944 and ended in a Soviet victory over German and Romanian forces; the page does not describe the area retaken, so the end of the Moldova bridge is confidence 1.
1944: liberation of France (the zone occupied in 1940).
1944: liberation of France (the former free zone).
1944: Monaco.
1944: Eupen-Malmedy goes.
1944: Estonia retaken.
1944: Lithuania retaken.
1944: Albania.
1944: Alsace-Lorraine goes.
1945: Serbian Military Administration to January 1945; Yugoslavia occupied until 15 May 1945.

1945: Danzig goes.

ledger.x: 1945: Denmark liberated: occupied until 5 May 1945.
1945: Norway occupied until 8 May 1945.
1945: Netherlands occupied until 20 May 1945 (the table's end date).
1945: the infobox gives 'Government dissolved: 8 May 1945' and 'Armed Forces surrender: 15 May 1945' (Independent State of Croatia); the client state ends with the Reich.
1945: Greece occupied until 8 May 1945.
1945: the occupation of the Czech lands ended in May 1945: the Prague uprising began 5 May, the Wehrmacht capitulated 8 May and 'Prague was taken on 9 May by Soviet troops'.
1945: the Slovak Republic ends in May 1945 (table).
1945: Italy, occupation to 2 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table).

1945: the zones end with the German surrender in Italy: the German and collaborationist troops of OZAK 'surrendered to the New Zealand 2nd Division on the evening of 2 May' (Operational Zone of the Adriatic Littoral); infobox 'Dissolution: 1945'.
1945: Hungary occupied until May 1945.
1945: Latvia.
1945: Guernsey, occupied until 9 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table).
1945: Jersey, occupied until 9 May 1945 (German-occupied Europe table).
1945: Berlin surrendered on 2 May 1945 and the German Instrument of Surrender was signed on 8 May.
1945: the war in the west ends with the surrender of 8 May 1945.
1945: the Sudetenland goes.
1945: northern Slovenia goes.

ledger.x: 1945: the Third Reich 'ended in May 1945, after 12 years': surrender 8 May 1945 (the Flensburg Government was arrested 23 May; the Berlin Declaration of 5/6 June assumed supreme authority; Potsdam 2 August moved the eastern border to the Oder-Neisse line).

wars.name: Invasion of Poland
wars.outcome: German victory: Poland occupied from 1 September 1939; decrees of 8 and 12 October 1939 annexed Wartheland, Danzig-West Prussia and two districts.

wars.name: Norwegian campaign
wars.outcome: German victory: Denmark fell in under a day and Norway 'was fully occupied by early June'.

wars.name: Battle of France
wars.outcome: German victory: attack ordered for May 1940, occupation of the Low Countries from 10 May, France 'surrendered on 22 June'.

wars.name: Balkan campaign
wars.outcome: Germany invaded Yugoslavia and Greece on 6 April 1941; Yugoslavia occupied and partly annexed, Greece occupied.

wars.name: Eastern Front (World War II)
wars.outcome: Invasion 22 June 1941; furthest advance 27 November 1941; Stalingrad surrender 31 January 1943; Kiev November 1943; the 1939 border regained 3 January 1944; Berlin surrendered 2 May 1945.

wars.name: Allied invasion of Germany
wars.outcome: Soviet invasion of Germany 13 January 1945; Western Allied invasion 22 March 1945; Berlin surrendered 2 May; instrument of surrender 8 May 1945.

wars.name: German occupation of Italy
wars.outcome: Germany occupied Italian territory from 8 September 1943 to 2 May 1945 with the Italian Social Republic.

certainty.note: Treaty and decree lines (Saar plebiscite, Munich Agreement, Memel treaty of 23 March 1939, the October 1939 decrees); the General Government and the Protectorate boundaries are soft.
Fronts moved monthly and the pages opened give few lines; the annexed-land boundaries stay sharp.
